# PLOS Journals

> A comprehensive collection of peer-reviewed, open-access journals spanning biomedical sciences, environmental research, public health, and computational disciplines.

PLOS (Public Library of Science) operates 16 specialized journals covering diverse research areas from genetics and medicine to climate science and digital health. All journals follow open-access principles, ensuring research is freely available to the global scientific community and the public.

## Key Topics

- Open-access publishing
- Peer-reviewed research
- Biomedical sciences
- Public health
- Climate and sustainability
- Computational biology
- Infectious diseases
- Genetics and evolution
- Environmental conservation
- Digital health and informatics
- Global health equity
- Aging research
- Neglected tropical diseases
- Mental health
- Water and sanitation

## Life Sciences and Medicine

- [PLOS Biology](https://journals.plos.org/plosbiology): Peer-reviewed open-access journal covering biology research and microbiome
- [PLOS Genetics](https://journals.plos.org/plosgenetics): Peer-reviewed journal for genetics, evolution, and molecular research
- [PLOS Computational Biology](https://journals.plos.org/ploscompbiol): Peer-reviewed journal covering computational biology and machine learning
- [PLOS Pathogens](https://journals.plos.org/plospathogens): Peer-reviewed journal for pathogen, infectious disease, and immunology research
- [PLOS Medicine](https://journals.plos.org/plosmedicine): Peer-reviewed journal for medical research, clinical studies, and health policy

## Health and Disease Research

- [PLOS Global Public Health](https://journals.plos.org/globalpublichealth): Open-access journal for global health, equity, and public health research
- [PLOS Aging and Health](https://journals.plos.org/agingandhealth): Open-access journal for aging and health research with editorial board
- [PLOS Mental Health](https://journals.plos.org/mentalhealth): Journal for mental health research covering anxiety, grief, and climate impacts
- [PLOS Digital Health](https://journals.plos.org/digitalhealth): Open-access journal for digital health, wearables, and health informatics
- [PLOS Neglected Tropical Diseases](https://journals.plos.org/plosntds): Research journal for neglected tropical and parasitic disease epidemiology

## Environmental and Climate Science

- [PLOS Climate](https://journals.plos.org/climate): Open-access journal for climate research, mitigation, and biodiversity
- [PLOS Ecosystems](https://journals.plos.org/ecosystems): Open-access journal for ecosystem research and biodiversity conservation
- [PLOS Water](https://journals.plos.org/water): Journal for water research, sanitation, and water-health-climate nexus
- [PLOS Sustainability and Transformation](https://journals.plos.org/sustainabilitytransformation): Open-access journal for sustainability, climate transition, and green energy

## Interdisciplinary Research

- [PLOS One](https://journals.plos.org/plosone): Multidisciplinary open-access peer-reviewed journal for scientific research
- [PLOS Complex Systems](https://journals.plos.org/complexsystems): Peer-reviewed journal for complex systems, networks, and machine learning
